1.1: This James right here, servin' God and our Lord Jesus Christ. I'm writin' to the twelve tribes that been scattered all over. What's good, fam?
1.2: My people, treat it like a win when life start tryna whoop you from every angle.
1.3: Know this: when your faith get tested, it build up that patience muscle.
1.4: But don't cut the process short—let patience do her full work so you can grow up, be whole, and not miss nothin'.
1.5: If any of y'all ain't got wisdom, go ahead and ask God. He give it out generous, no side-eye, no judgment—and He'll make sure you get it.
1.6: But when you ask, do it with full faith—no doubtin'. 'Cause the one who doubtin' is like a wave tossed around by the wind—real shaky.
1.7: That kinda person shouldn't expect to get anything from the Lord.
1.8: They got two minds and can't keep still in nothin' they do.
1.9: If you broke or low in status, go ahead and brag about how God liftin' you up.
1.10: And if you rich, go ahead and humble yourself, 'cause like flowers in the field, you ain't gon' be around forever.
1.11: Soon as that hot sun come up, the grass shrivel up, the flower fall, and all that beauty gone. Same way the rich gon' fade out in the middle of they hustle.
1.12: Blessed is the one who hang in there through temptation—'cause when they pass the test, they gon' get that crown of life God promised to the ones that love Him.
1.13: Don't nobody say, "God tryna tempt me," 'cause God don't get tempted by evil and He ain't out here temptin' nobody.
1.14: We get tempted when our own wants drag us off and trap us.
1.15: Then them desires get pregnant, and what they birth? Sin. And when sin grow all the way up, it bring death to the party.
1.17: Every good and perfect thing we got come straight from the Father of lights. He don't switch up or throw shade.
1.18: He chose to give us new life through the word of truth so we could be like the first of many new creations.
1.19: So hear me out, fam: be quick to listen, slow to talk, and real slow to pop off in anger.
1.20: 'Cause human anger don't produce the kinda righteousness God on.
1.21: Drop all that nasty mess and evil overflowin' in your life. Instead, receive that word God planted in you—it's powerful enough to save your soul.
1.22: Don't just listen to the word and think you good. That's playin' yourself. Do what it say.
1.23: If you just hear it but don't do nothin', you like somebody who look in the mirror—
1.24: Then walk off and forget what they even look like.
1.25: But if you look into God's perfect law that sets you free, and you stick with it—don't just hear it then bounce, but actually do it—you gon' be blessed in what you do.
1.26: If you think you holy but can't control your tongue, you straight up foolin' yourself. Your religion don't mean nothin'.
1.27: Real, pure religion in God's eyes is this: look out for orphans and widows when they strugglin', and keep yourself from gettin' dirtied up by this wild world.

2.1: Fam, if you claimin' to believe in our Lord Jesus Christ—the real MVP, the glory King—then stop showin' favoritism. That don't match up.
2.2: Say a dude walks in with gold rings and drippin' in designer, and then another one pull up lookin' dusty and broke…
2.3: And you treat the flashy one like royalty—"Ayy, take this good seat"—but tell the broke one, "Stand over there," or "Sit down here on the floor by my feet,"
2.4: Ain't you just made yourself the judge, with evil intentions in your heart?
2.5: Listen up, fam: Didn't God choose the ones the world sleep on—the poor—to be rich in faith and to inherit the Kingdom He promised to those who love Him?
2.6: But y'all done disrespected the poor. And ain't it the rich folks that be oppressin' y'all and draggin' you to court?
2.7: Ain't it them that be talkin' wild about the name y'all claim?
2.8: If you really out here livin' that "love your neighbor as yourself" life, like the Scriptures say, then you doin' right.
2.9: But if you show favoritism, you sinnin'. Period. The law gon' call you out as a lawbreaker.
2.10: 'Cause if you follow the whole law but mess up on just one thing, it's like you broke the whole thing.
2.11: The same God who said, "Don't cheat" also said, "Don't kill." So if you ain't out here cheating but you killin', you still outta pocket.
2.12: So talk and act like folks who gon' be judged by the law that sets you free.
2.13: 'Cause if you ain't got mercy for others, don't expect mercy in your judgment. Mercy always wins over judgment.
2.14: What's the point, fam, if somebody say they got faith but don't back it up with action? That kind of faith can't save nobody.
2.15: Suppose one of our own ain't got clothes or food for the day—
2.16: And you say, "Be blessed, stay warm and eat good!" but don't actually help them out…what good is that?
2.17: Same goes for faith. If it don't come with works, it's dead. D-E-A-D.
2.18: Somebody might say, "You got faith, I got works." Aight—show me your faith with no works, and I'll show you mine through what I do.
2.19: You believe there's one God? Cool. Even demons believe that—and they shakin' in their boots.
2.20: But you still tryna act like faith don't need action? Boy, if you don't—faith without works is dead!
2.21: Remember Abraham, our forefather? Wasn't he considered righteous 'cause he put in work—offerin' up Isaac, his own son, on the altar?
2.22: See, his faith and actions were tag-teamin'. His works made his faith complete.
2.23: That's why Scripture says, "Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness." And they even called him God's friend.
2.24: So you see, people get right with God by what they do, not just by what they say they believe.
2.25: And don't forget Rahab the harlot—sis showed faith by hidin' the spies and sneakin' them out another way. That was workin' faith, too.
2.26: Just like a body without breath is dead, faith without works is dead, too.

3.1: Look, fam—don't everybody try to be a teacher. Know that teachers get judged harder than most.
3.2: We all mess up in a lotta ways. But if you can control your mouth? You on point. That means you got discipline over your whole body too.
3.3: Think about it—when we put bits in a horse's mouth, we can steer the whole thing wherever we want.
3.4: Same with a ship—big ol' boat, strong winds, but a tiny lil' rudder directs it wherever the captain steerin'.
3.5: That's how the tongue is. It's small, but it talks big! Just takes a lil' spark to set a whole forest on fire.
3.6: That tongue? Straight up fire. It's a whole world of wickedness. It messes up your whole self, burns through your life like wildfire—and hell itself be sparkin' it.
3.7: Humans done tamed all kinds of animals—beasts, birds, reptiles, sea creatures. We got all that on lock.
3.8: But nobody can fully tame the tongue. It's wild, evil, full of deadly venom.
3.9: One minute we usin' it to bless God our Father—and the next, we cussin' folks made in His image.
3.10: Same mouth talkin' blessings and curses? That ain't right, fam. That ain't how it's supposed to be.
3.11: Do a spring shoot out both fresh water and bitter water from the same spot?
3.12: Can a fig tree grow olives? Can a grapevine grow figs? Nah. And the same way, saltwater ain't gon' give you fresh water.
3.13: Who out here think they wise and smart? Then show it by how you live—let your actions be humble and full of wisdom.
3.14: But if you carryin' bitter envy and out-for-self vibes in your heart, don't be out here frontin' and lyin' on the truth.
3.15: That ain't God's kind of wisdom. That's worldly, flesh-driven, and straight-up demonic.
3.16: Wherever you got envy and selfishness, confusion and every kind of mess is right there with it.
3.17: But the wisdom that come from above? It's pure first. Then peace-lovin', gentle, open to correction, full of mercy, heavy on good fruit, no favoritism, no fakin'.
3.18: And the ones who plant peace? They gon' harvest righteousness. Peace grows what's right.

4.1: Where all these beefs and fights y'all got come from? Ain't it from the stuff y'all want so bad inside that it got you fightin' your own self?
4.2: You want what you don't got, so you ready to kill. You jealous, but still can't get what you want. So you fight and war. But you still don't got it—'cause you ain't even askin' God.
4.3: And when you do ask, you don't get it 'cause your motives all jacked up. You just want it for your own pleasure.
4.4: Y'all cheatin' on God like spiritual side pieces! Don't you know bein' tight with the world means you beefin' with God? If you wanna be cool with the world, you just made yourself God's enemy.
4.5: Or you think the Word was playin' when it said, "The Spirit God put in us is jealous for us"?
4.6: But He got grace on grace for us. That's why the Scriptures say: "God stands against the proud, But pours grace on the humble."
4.7: So stop fightin'—submit to God. Push back on the devil and he gon' dip.
4.8: Come close to God and He gon' come close to you. Wash your hands, y'all who been wildin'. Get your heart right, you double-minded folks.
4.9: Cry it out. Mourn. Weep. Stop laughin' like everything funny. Let that joy turn to real repentance.
4.10: Humble yourself in front of the Lord—and He gon' lift you up.
4.11: Don't talk down on each other, fam. If you talk bad about your brother and judge him, you ain't just clownin' him—you clownin' God's law. And if you judge the law, you not obeyin' it… you tryna act like you above it.
4.12: There's only one real Judge and Lawgiver—He the one who can save or destroy. So who are you to be out here judgin' somebody else?
4.13: Look here—you who always say, "We gon' hit this city, post up for a year, stack up some bread and flip it…"
4.14: Y'all don't even know what tomorrow got in store. Your life? It's like steam off a cup—shows up for a second then gone.
4.15: Instead, you oughta be sayin', "If the Lord willin', we'll live and make moves."
4.16: But now y'all braggin' and flexin'. That kinda pride? That's evil.
4.17: So if you know the right thing to do and still don't do it? That's sin—period.

5.1: Aight now, all y'all stackin' money dirty—go ahead and cry, holler even, 'cause misery comin' your way.
5.2: Your money gettin' moldy, your designer clothes got moth bites—ain't nothin' lastin'.
5.3: Your gold and silver rusted up, and that rust gon' testify against you. It's gon' eat you up like fire. All that treasure you stacked? You hoardin' in the last days like there's no judgment comin'.
5.4: The folks who cut your grass and worked your fields? You cheated them. Their unpaid wages out here cryin' out—and God heard 'em loud and clear.
5.5: Y'all been livin' it up, luxury style, fattenin' up like animals before slaughter.
5.6: You judged and killed the innocent—and they ain't even fight back.
5.7: So fam, be patient till the Lord come back. Think about a farmer—he waitin' on that good harvest, gotta hold tight through the early rain and the late rain.
5.8: You do the same. Get your heart solid—Jesus on the way.
5.9: Stop grumblin' 'bout each other, or you gon' get judged too. The Judge already standin' at the door—He right there.
5.10: Look at the prophets, y'all. They went through it while speakin' God's name. They stayed down. Follow that example.
5.11: We call folks blessed when they hold on through the storm. Y'all heard about Job, right? How he kept pushin'? And saw how God flipped it in the end? God don't play about His compassion and mercy.
5.12: And most important—stop swearin' on stuff: no oaths, no "on God," no "on my mama." Just say "yes" or "no." Keep it simple and solid so you don't end up in judgment.
5.13: Anybody goin' through it? Pray. Got joy? Sing about it.
5.14: Somebody sick? Call the church elders. Let 'em pray over you and put oil on you in Jesus' name.
5.15: That kind of prayer—rooted in faith—can heal the sick, and the Lord gon' lift 'em up. If they messed up, they gon' be forgiven too.
5.16: Confess what you've done wrong to each other, and pray for each other, so healing can happen. Real prayer from a righteous one? That joint powerful and effective.
5.17: Elijah was just a regular dude like us—but when he prayed hard for the rain to stop, it ain't rain for 3½ years!
5.18: Then he prayed again—and boom, rain came and the earth started growin' again.
5.19: Listen, fam—if somebody in the crew drifts off from the truth, and you help bring 'em back?
5.20: Just know: you helped save a soul from death and covered up a whole bunch of sins.
